in_marathi.name: Arkarsh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Chariot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arkarsh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arkarsh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'arka' meaning chariot and 'rish' meaning lord. In Hindu mythology, Arkarsh is the name of the charioteer of the sun god Surya. He is responsible for guiding the sun across the sky each day.
